name: Grasping Vines
base_description: Weeds and vines burst from the ground, coiling around anything nearby.

name: Honeyed Urging
base_description: Your words plant an idea that seems entirely reasonable to the listener.

name: Timefreeze
base_description: Time stops for all but you.

name: Cast Out
base_description: You travel through or call forth folded starlit space. the rift hums loudly

name: Whirlpool
base_description: Bonds of rushing water lock a creature in place. needs water nearby

name: Trap Circle
base_description: Bonds of pale soul-light lock a creature in place. shaken by strong emotion

name: Sleep Glyph
base_description: Bonds of pale soul-light lock a creature in place. shaken by strong emotion

name: Force Grip
base_description: Bonds of blazing starlight lock a creature in place. weak in darkness

name: Muscle Lock
base_description: You cramp a creature's muscles so it can't move. you must touch them

name: Nerve Pinch
base_description: A pinch on a nerve freezes a limb. only on the living

name: Rot Grip
base_description: Rotting hands burst from the ground and hold a creature. the ground is left dead

name: Static Grip
base_description: A charge locks a foe's muscles in place. metal armor protects them

name: Lightning Cage
base_description: Bars of lightning trap a creature. it shocks you if you get near

name: Water Bubble
base_description: A floating sphere of water traps a creature inside. it can drown if you don't release it

name: Stuck Moment
base_description: You freeze a creature in a single repeating second. you must keep your eyes on it

name: Slow Field
base_description: Arrows and blades crawl through the air around you. you move slowly inside it too

name: Timelock
base_description: A door or chest is locked in a moment no one can open. you can't open it either until it ends

name: Heart Grip
base_description: You squeeze a creature's heart from afar and it freezes. you feel every beat it struggles

name: Numbing Bite
base_description: A dose of paralytic venom stiffens a creature's limbs. poison-immune creatures ignore it

name: Spider Silk
base_description: Sticky, toxic threads lash a creature in place. the silk stings you as you spin it

name: Deadlock Toxin
base_description: A powerful venom freezes every muscle in the body. you must stay close enough to touch

name: Abyssal Grasp
base_description: Writhing black tendrils rise to clutch and crush.

name: Mindbind
base_description: You seize control of a humanoid's mind.

name: Stoneflesh
base_description: A creature's flesh slowly hardens into stone.

name: Crowd Urging
base_description: Your words plant ideas in many minds at once.

name: Will Seize
base_description: You seize control of any creature's mind.

name: Labyrinth
base_description: A creature is lost in a twisting maze.

name: Stunning Utterance
base_description: A single word stuns a creature.

name: Eternal Prison
base_description: A creature is bound in an eternal prison.

name: Warm Regard
base_description: A creature suddenly sees you as a trusted friend, at least for a while.

name: Body Lock
base_description: A humanoid freezes in place, its muscles locked by your magic.

name: Beastbind
base_description: You seize control of a beast's mind.

name: Halt
base_description: Bonds of pale soul-light lock a creature in place. shaken by strong emotion

name: Prism Cage
base_description: An invisible cage of force traps a creature.

name: Grovel
base_description: You mark a foe with pale soul-light that clings and gnaws. shaken by strong emotion

name: Compel Dance
base_description: A creature dances wildly, unable to stop.

name: Dreadweave
base_description: Nightmare illusions stalk many minds at once.

name: Terror Wave
base_description: A wave of dread sends creatures fleeing in panic.

name: Knuckle Crack
base_description: Melee spell attack: 1d10 bludgeoning, and an object or barrier you hit takes double. 2d10 at 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17.

name: Frozen Moment
base_description: You freeze a moment in time around a creature. It must make a Judgment roll or be paralyzed, unable to move or act.

name: Frostcut Pebble
base_description: Make a fist-sized stone or ice tool (wedge, hook, key blank) that lasts until your next long rest.

name: Starmend
base_description: A creature regains 1 HP, or a dying creature becomes stable. Once per creature per short rest.

name: Shadow Double
base_description: A shadowy copy of you shimmers for 1 round; the next attack against you has disadvantage.

name: Hearthstone
base_description: Casting time 1 minute. Make a palm-sized stone that stays warm (or burns with a candle flame) for 8 hours.

name: Infernal Mandate
base_description: A 30-ft aura around you for 10 rounds (1 minute). Allies in the aura (you included) add +1d6 fire to weapon hits, have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed, and gain resistance to fire. Enemies that start their turn in the aura take 2d6 fire (no save). The spell ends early if you drop to 0 HP.

name: Iron Pulse
base_description: Body Magic. Your next weapon hit before the spell ends (1 round) deals +1d4 damage of the weapon's type (1d6 at L11, 1d8 at L17). No attack or save.

name: War Trance
base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. You gain temporary HP equal to 2d10 + your level and can't be frightened for 10 rounds (1 minute). Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, you can reroll it.

name: Spirit Latch
base_description: Seal a door, box or window for 1 hour; spirits can't pass it, and opening it takes a DC 12 Presence check.

name: Soulmirage
base_description: A faint, ghostly image of a creature or object up to 5 ft for 1 minute; it can't make sound. Knowledge against your DC reveals it.

name: Whisper Wind
base_description: Create a sound or a puff of shaped mist up to a 5-ft cube for 1 minute; a Knowledge check against your spell DC reveals it.

name: Gloomrot
base_description: One creature makes a Judgment roll or takes 1d6 necrotic and has -1d4 on its next attack (2d6 at 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17).

name: Bend Water
base_description: Choose water you can see in an area up to a 5-ft cube (10 rounds / 1 hour). Move it up to 5 ft or change its flow; shape it into simple forms that hold; make it clear or cloudy; or freeze or thaw it if no bigger than a 1-ft cube. Up to two effects at once. Area: 10-ft cube at 5, 15-ft at 11, 20-ft at 17.

name: Frost Punch
base_description: Melee spell attack: 1d8 cold. 2d8 at 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17. (Provisional: mirrors Spark Grip until the handbook sets its mechanics.)

name: Ember Spark
base_description: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object. On a hit it takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object that isn't worn or carried catches fire. 2d10 at 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17.

name: Grit Spit
base_description: Make a ranged spell attack: 1d8 bludgeoning. 2d8 at 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

name: Soul Link
base_description: Reaver signature cantrip. You link one creature you can see within 60 ft (10 rounds in combat, 1 hour out of combat; no attack or save to place). The first time you hit it with a weapon attack on each of your turns, it takes an extra 1d6 necrotic (1d8 at L5, 1d10 at L11, 2d6 at L17). You have advantage on checks to track or find it. If it drops to 0 HP before the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a later turn to move the link to a new creature you can see within 60 ft. Only one link at a time; casting it again ends the old one. When you place or move the link, choose one. Weaken: the linked creature subtracts 1d4 from its first attack roll each turn against anyone but you. Strengthen: you gain temporary HP equal to your Confidence modifier (minimum 1) each time the extra damage triggers.

name: Vein Snare
base_description: One creature you can see makes a Endurance roll. On a failure it takes 1d4 necrotic and its speed drops by 10 ft until the end of its next turn; on a success nothing happens. Creatures without blood are immune. 2d4 at 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

name: Breath Iron
base_description: Self or one willing creature you touch (10 rounds / 10 minutes) adds +1d4 to its next Might or Endurance check or Endurance roll, and can hold its breath 10 times as long. Ends once the die is used. Once per creature per short rest. Die: 1d6 at 5, 1d8 at 11, 1d10 at 17.

name: Pact Vigor
base_description: You and up to 2 allies within 30 ft each gain temporary HP equal to 2d8 + your Confidence modifier and add +1d4 to weapon damage rolls for 10 rounds (1 minute). No attack or save. Upcast: +1d8 temporary HP per slot level above 4th.

name: Limb Wither
base_description: Body Magic. Endurance roll. On a failed save the target takes 1d6 necrotic (2d6 at L5, 3d6 at L11, 4d6 at L17) and has -1d4 on its next weapon damage roll before the end of its next turn. On a success, nothing happens.

name: Hobbling Strike
base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. Bonus action after you hit a creature with a weapon. For 10 rounds (1 minute) its speed is halved and it can't take reactions. It makes a Endurance roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Body Magic doesn't upcast.

name: Unstrung
base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. 60 ft. Endurance roll. On a failure the target takes 3d8 necrotic and for 10 rounds (1 minute) has disadvantage on Might and Precision checks and saves and deals half damage with weapon attacks; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success. On a successful initial save it takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

name: Ironbrawn
base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. For 10 rounds (1 minute) you grow one size if there's room, gain advantage on Might checks and saves, your weapon hits deal +1d6, and your reach grows by 5 ft. No attack or save.

name: Painecho
base_description: You force a creature to relive its oldest wound. It must make a Judgment roll, taking psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Static Bloom
base_description: A burst of sparks blooms at a point you choose. Each creature nearby must make a Precision roll or take lightning damage.

name: Razorwind
base_description: A blade-sharp sheet of wind sweeps across an area. Each creature in it must make a Precision roll, taking slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Hourglass Prison
base_description: You trap a creature in a prison of slowed time. It must make a Judgment roll or be stuck, barely able to move or act.

name: Soulswap
base_description: You rip two creatures' souls out of their bodies and swap them. Each must make a Confidence roll or wake up trapped in the other's body.

name: Bonegarden
base_description: Skeletal hands burst out of the ground in an area and drag at your foes. Each creature in the area must make a Endurance roll, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Deathless Vigor
base_description: Necromantic power bolsters you with a borrowed, hollow vitality.

name: Cloudwalk
base_description: Creatures turn to cloud and ride the winds.

name: Spiritwalk
base_description: You step into the spirit realm, unseen by the living.

name: Compelling Pull
base_description: Creatures are compelled to move where you will them.

name: Soul Vessel
base_description: Your soul leaves your body and dwells in an object.

name: Homecall
base_description: You and your allies instantly return to a sacred place.

name: Heartwish
base_description: Your deepest wish reshapes reality itself.

name: Howling Screen
base_description: A wall of howling wind deflects arrows and gusts.

name: Coral Shield
base_description: You grow a shield of hard coral. it dries and crumbles out of water

name: Afterimage
base_description: You leave copies of yourself a second behind. they copy only your last move

name: Future Glimpse
base_description: A foe sees a false vision of what you'll do next. you must do something else

name: Echo Self
base_description: A copy of you from a moment ago fights beside you. it fades in seconds

name: Recall Object
base_description: An object you held earlier today returns to your hand. it vanishes from wherever it was

name: Exile
base_description: A creature vanishes to a distant plane, banished from your sight.

name: Sticky Weave
base_description: Thick, sticky webs fill an area, ensnaring anything caught inside.

name: Past Army
base_description: Soldiers who once fought here return for one battle. they fight for whoever once owned the land

name: Haste Time
base_description: Time speeds up around a plant, food or wound. it also rots or ages faster

name: Restore Ruin
base_description: A broken thing returns to how it was before it broke. only if it broke today

name: Sundial Mark
base_description: A small mark always shows you the true time. it glows faintly

name: Hour Vault
base_description: You build a room where time stands still. you age normally while inside

name: Draw Poison
base_description: You pull poison out of a wound into your own palm. you take a little of it yourself

name: Stillpocket
base_description: A pocket of stopped time no blow can cross. you can’t act out of it either

name: Riptide Pull
base_description: A current drags a creature down and holds it there. only works in water

name: Tempo Shift
base_description: You bend time around a creature, either speeding up an ally or slowing down a foe. An unwilling target makes a Judgment roll to resist.

name: Grace Bolt
base_description: Wraith only. Evocation cantrip; 1 action; range 60 ft; components V, S. A chain of radiant light lashes out. Make a ranged spell attack (proficiency + Intellect). On a hit, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage (don't add Intellect to damage). Beams: 1 at levels 1-4, 2 at 5-10, 3 at 11-16, 4 at 17-30. Each beam is a separate attack roll; aim them at the same target or different ones. Once per turn, when a beam hits a Large or smaller creature, you can pull it up to 5 ft toward you. Counts toward your cantrip limit.

name: Taint Water
base_description: You turn water or drink foul with a touch. you can't undo it

name: Fume Steer
base_description: You guide a cloud of toxic vapor with your hand. a strong wind takes it from you

name: Hallucinate
base_description: A small, silent illusion shimmers into being, real enough to fool a passing glance.

name: Bend Stone
base_description: Under your palms, solid stone softens like clay and takes whatever form you press into it.

name: Wildsign
base_description: You read the wind for weather, coax a bud to bloom, or stir the leaves with a whisper of the wild.

name: Omen Sign
base_description: The ground trembles, flames flicker, and your voice booms with the weight of the heavens.

name: Shimmerblur
base_description: Your form wavers and blurs, making you hard to strike.

name: Prey Brand
base_description: You mark your prey with a hunter's magic, sensing its every move.

name: Rainspoon
base_description: You draw a cup of glowing rain from the air. A creature that drinks it regains a small amount of health.

name: Tribunal of Souls
base_description: The spirits of ancient judges stand beside your allies, protecting them from being frightened or charmed.

name: Heartbeat Theft
base_description: You steal a heartbeat from time and act a moment sooner, improving your place in the initiative order.

name: Living Cathedral
base_description: You reshape an ally's body into a fortress, greatly boosting their health and toughness.

name: Unwind
base_description: You rewind a moment for an ally, letting them reroll an attack, check, or save they just failed.

name: Titan's Sinew
base_description: An ally swells with a giant's strength, letting them lift, carry, and hit much harder.

name: Babel Kiss
base_description: You touch a creature's lips, letting it speak and understand every language it hears.

name: Lanternmoth
base_description: A moth of golden light flutters from your hands and follows you, shining like a lantern.

name: Wisp of the Pale Star
base_description: You call a mote of starlight that hovers where you point and lights the area around it.

name: Riftwalk
base_description: You tear open space and step through to any place you have seen with your own eyes.

name: Door Beyond the Stars
base_description: You open a doorway to another plane of existence. You and your allies can step through to any world you name.

name: Skyshift
base_description: You fold the air and step through it, teleporting to a spot you can see within range.

name: Verdant Hand
base_description: A hand of woven vines grows from the ground to fetch, carry, or pull things for you.

name: Keepward
base_description: Wards protect a stronghold against intruders.

name: Briarchain
base_description: Thorned vines lash out of the ground and wrap around a creature. It must make a Might roll or be restrained and take piercing damage from the thorns.

name: Moonpull Tide
base_description: You command the tides to drag a creature. It must make a Might roll or be pulled wherever you choose.

name: Stillfrost Grasp
base_description: Your touch encases a creature or object in hoarfrost. A creature must make a Endurance roll or be frozen in place for a moment.

name: Verdant Uprising
base_description: A forest erupts from the ground, and its branches grab at everything nearby. Each creature in the area must make a Might roll or be restrained.

name: Grit Storm
base_description: You kick up a whirling cloud of grit. Each creature inside must make a Endurance roll or be blinded.

name: Mistwalk Veil
base_description: A silver mist rises around you and blurs your form. Attacks against you are made at disadvantage.

name: Starward Ward
base_description: A lattice of starlight surrounds you. The next attack that hits you is turned aside harmlessly.

name: Mountain's Root
base_description: Your feet root into the ground like a mountain. Nothing can push, pull, or knock you prone.

name: Starless Night
base_description: You fill an area with magical, moonless darkness that ordinary light can't penetrate.

name: Diamond Skin
base_description: You turn an ally's skin to living diamond, making them much harder to hit and letting blades glance off.

name: Nightfold
base_description: You fold the shadows around an area into a pocket of silent, magical darkness.

name: Loom of Silence
base_description: You create a zone of total silence. No sound can be made inside it, and spells that need a voice can't be cast there.

name: Breath of the Deep
base_description: You fill a creature's lungs with enchanted air, letting it breathe underwater or in thick smoke.

name: Glacierwall
base_description: A wall of blue ice bursts from the ground, giving you cover and blocking attacks from the other side.

name: Pyre Halo
base_description: A halo of fire crowns an ally. Any creature that hits or grabs them takes fire damage.

name: Astral Sidestep
base_description: You slip half a step into the astral sea, letting an attack pass harmlessly through you.

name: Inkfall Eclipse
base_description: You blot out the sun over an area and fill it with liquid darkness that ordinary light can't penetrate.

name: Float
base_description: You make an object float weightless. it drifts in the wind

name: Gale Avenue
base_description: A corridor of roaring wind blasts out in a line. Each creature in the line must make a Might roll or be hurled along its path.

name: Kindle Whisper
base_description: You command a flame you can see to dance, flare up, or gutter out. You can also make the fire lash out and burn a creature near it.

name: Echo of the Unseen
base_description: You send a whisper through the air that returns to tell you what is waiting on the other side of a door or wall.

name: Ashen Path
base_description: You leave a trail of glowing ash footprints that only you and allies you choose can see.

name: Bloodread
base_description: You taste a drop of a creature's blood and learn about it: how wounded it is, what it fears, and what it last ate.

name: Hearthseed
base_description: You conjure a steady, smokeless flame in your palm. It gives off light and warmth and can be used to light things, but doesn't burn you.

name: Greenwhisper
base_description: You listen to the plants around you, and they tell you what has passed among them in the last day.

name: Stormthread
base_description: You catch a bolt of lightning on your fingertip and redirect it, turning an incoming lightning attack or spell toward a target you choose.

name: Loom of the World
base_description: You pull the threads of reality and restore a broken structure, like a bridge, wall, or ruin, as if it were new.

name: Oak's Watch
base_description: You touch a tree and borrow its senses, letting you see and hear everything that passes beneath its branches.

name: Stonewright's Touch
base_description: You soften stone with your touch so you can sculpt it with your fingers like clay.

name: Bloodsight
base_description: Your eyes turn crimson and you can see the heartbeat of every living creature nearby, even through walls.

name: Rime Seal
base_description: You breathe on a lock, jar, or door and freeze it shut under a sheet of magic ice.

name: Heartsight
base_description: You see every heart within range glowing through flesh, and you know how close each creature is to death.

name: Soulthread
base_description: You link the minds of willing allies with an astral thread so they can share thoughts telepathically.

name: Bloodward
base_description: You paint a ward in your own blood. It absorbs the next harmful spell aimed at you.

name: Echo of Yesterday
base_description: You replay the last minute of time around you like a ghostly echo, letting you see what just happened in the area.

name: Sealbreaker
base_description: You speak a word of unmaking that shatters magical seals, locks, and wards in front of you.

name: Umbral Lance
base_description: You hurl a spear of living shadow at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the shadow pierces it with frost-dark cold.

name: Thunderneedle
base_description: You fire a needle of lightning at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it punches through armor and deals lightning damage.

name: Sunspear
base_description: You call down a lance of sunlight on a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it takes radiant damage, and undead are hit especially hard.

name: Flame Lash
base_description: A whip of liquid fire uncoils from your hand and lashes a creature. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit, it takes fire damage.

name: Glacial Dart
base_description: You hurl a shard of glacier ice at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it takes cold damage.

name: Starfall Barrage
base_description: You pull down a storm of falling stars across the battlefield. Each creature in the area must make a Precision roll, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Phoenix Fan
base_description: You sweep your arm and send out a cone of burning phoenix feathers. Each creature in the cone must make a Precision roll, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Tectonic Pulse
base_description: The earth heaves and splits beneath your enemies. Each creature in the area must make a Precision roll, taking bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Wildfire Chain
base_description: Fire leaps from foe to foe like a living thing. Each creature it reaches must make a Precision roll, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Skyhammer
base_description: You call down a pillar of lightning on a point you choose. Each creature there must make a Precision roll, taking lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Winter's Throne
base_description: You call down a raging blizzard over an area. Each creature caught in it must make a Endurance roll, taking cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Void Pull
base_description: A foe is tugged toward an unseen rift. it tugs you too

name: Steady Hands
base_description: You mark an ally with your blood, steadying their arms. Their weapon attacks become more accurate.

name: Venomsip
base_description: You draw poison out of a creature's wound and flick it away harmlessly, ending the poison's effect.

name: Ghostward Hush
base_description: You quiet the restless dead around you. Spirits and undead in the area can't harm the living while the spell lasts.

name: Choir of Iron
base_description: You sing, and your allies' weapons ring in answer. While your song lasts, their weapon attacks deal extra damage.

name: Mind Palace
base_description: You build a palace of thought in your mind, sharpening your focus. The next spell you cast costs less to cast.

name: Beastcalm
base_description: You speak soothingly to a wild creature, and it comes to see you as a friend.

name: Phoenix Rebirth
base_description: Flames consume a dying ally, and they rise from the ashes healed and cured of poison and disease.

name: Orbit of the Lost Moon
base_description: A small moon of astral light circles you and blocks the first attack against you each round.

name: Hollow Choir
base_description: Ghostly voices sing from nowhere. Each enemy that hears them must make a Judgment roll or become confused and lose its way.

name: Winter's Kiss
base_description: You blow a kiss of winter at a creature. It must make a Endurance roll or take cold damage and have its speed reduced.

name: Mirrorflash
base_description: You flash conjured light from a silver mirror at a creature. It must make a Endurance roll or be blinded.

name: Glare of the Sunken Eye
base_description: Your eyes flash with drowned starlight at a creature that meets your gaze. It must make a Endurance roll or be blinded until your next turn.

name: Hex of Whispers
base_description: You whisper a curse in a dead tongue at a creature. It must make a Judgment roll or take psychic damage as the words sap its nerve.

name: Emberbind
base_description: Ropes of smoldering ash coil around a creature's feet. It must make a Precision roll or take fire damage and have its speed reduced.

name: Groundsplit
base_description: You stamp and the ground cracks open under a creature. It must make a Precision roll or take bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

name: Drowned Dream
base_description: You fill a creature's mind with the feeling of drowning. It must make a Judgment roll or be incapacitated as it struggles for air.

name: Viper's Kiss
base_description: Venom wells from your fingertips as you touch a creature. It must make a Endurance roll, taking poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Grand Illusion
base_description: A vivid, moving illusion fills the scene with sight, sound, and smell.

name: Scar Ledger
base_description: You burn a rotting sigil into a creature's flesh. It must make a Endurance roll or take necrotic damage and be unable to regain health until your next turn.

name: Rot Hymn
base_description: You sing a song of decay, and wood, rope, and flesh around you rot away. Each creature in the area must make a Endurance roll, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Withering Tithe
base_description: You drain the life from everything around you, withering plants and foes alike. Each creature in the area must make a Endurance roll, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Blackened Sun
base_description: You brand a creature with an eclipse. It must make a Confidence roll or burn with sunlight and freeze with shadow, taking damage at the start of each of its turns.

name: Sunmend
base_description: Radiant warmth knits wounds closed. weak in darkness

name: Cold Pack
base_description: Frost numbs and seals a wound. the target is slowed briefly

name: Sap Salve
base_description: Healing sap seeps into the wound. heals slowly over time

name: Cleansing Tide
base_description: Clear water washes a wound clean and closes it. needs water nearby

name: Rot Graft
base_description: Dead flesh grafts in to fill the wound. lowers max HP until rest

name: Wraithbond
base_description: You bind a wandering spirit to your will. It must make a Confidence roll or be forced to answer your questions truthfully.

name: Last Breath
base_description: You steady a dying creature, holding its fading life in place.

name: Hearthberries
base_description: A handful of berries glows with magic, each one as filling as a meal.

name: Herb Poultice
base_description: Casting time 1 minute. Needs herbs nearby (a pinch from a pack counts). Bind a living creature with a herbal wrap: it regains 1d4 HP, or a dying creature becomes stable. Once per creature per short rest. No effect on undead or constructs. 2d4 at 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

name: Night Balm
base_description: Cool darkness soothes and closes wounds. fails in bright light

name: Antivenom
base_description: A tiny dose of poison purges a greater one. leaves the target queasy

name: Starlight Rest
base_description: Rest under starlight restores body and mind. only at night

name: Soul Anchor
base_description: You pull a fading soul back toward its body. you feel hollow afterward

name: Dawn Touch
base_description: Morning light eases pain and sickness. only during the day

name: Warm Glow
base_description: Warmth chases off cold and eases pain. makes you thirsty

name: Dark Rest
base_description: A blanket of darkness gives deep, healing sleep. wakes in bright light

name: Fresh Breath
base_description: Clean air clears a choking ally's lungs. it scatters fumes onto others

name: Ice Splint
base_description: Ice holds a broken limb steady while it heals. numbs the limb

name: Bonemend
base_description: Old bone grafts close a gaping wound. the patient feels cold

name: Shock Revival
base_description: A jolt wakes an unconscious ally. it hurts

name: Storm Mending
base_description: A charge speeds healing in torn muscles. leaves the patient jittery

name: Spring Water
base_description: A spring of clean, healing water bubbles up. only works where there's ground water

name: Tidal Renewal
base_description: Waves of healing water wash over every ally. everyone ends up drenched

name: Serpent's Draught
base_description: You coat your weapon in serpent venom. The next creature you hit must make a Endurance roll or take poison damage.
